authority.A: BCP V0.7 AX15GO SEALED / APIAX07 continuity and preconception lineage
authority.B: R77 research-backed engineering expansion using current Android/edge/local-first constraints
authority.C: accumulated field feedback and operating rules through 2026-09-21

CODE_PRESENT.meaning: implementation exists but not fully field-proven

DESIGN_ONLY.meaning: durable design/spec exists; implementation proof incomplete

note: This is a conservative evidence-maturity score, not a marketing completion number. Evidence state must be updated by readback/CI/field proof, never by prose alone.

requirements.title: Canonical project identity/state
requirements.requirement: One canonical project identity, revision/head and current mission state survive conversations/devices.

requirements.title: Operational memory
requirements.requirement: Structured project/user/technical/operating/history/policy memory with provenance and authority classes.

requirements.title: Bounded permissions
requirements.requirement: Named operations, least privilege, R0-R4-style bounded authority; no arbitrary shell as normal API.

requirements.title: Idempotent jobs
requirements.requirement: Jobs have stable IDs/idempotency, bounded retries and duplicate suppression.

requirements.title: Receipts and evidence
requirements.requirement: Side effects produce machine-readable receipts/readback before COMMITTED/SUCCESS.

requirements.title: Offline continuity
requirements.requirement: Loss of Internet must not destroy project state or queued work.

requirements.title: Deterministic recovery
requirements.requirement: Recovery resumes the next uncommitted action rather than replaying committed work.

requirements.title: ChatGPT orchestration
requirements.requirement: ChatGPT reasons/orchestrates while durable external state remains authoritative.

requirements.title: ChatGPT-PC Windows worker
requirements.requirement: Windows node executes bounded Windows-only/heavy work and exposes telemetry/receipts.

requirements.title: Dedicated Android B-EDGE
requirements.requirement: Old Android phone is a permanent dedicated B-EDGE node, not merely a UI accessory.

requirements.title: BuildHub build factory
requirements.requirement: Build/test packaging is offloaded to a build factory/CI path instead of overloading low-RAM PC.

requirements.title: Drive durable mirror
requirements.requirement: Drive holds CURRENT/installers/telemetry/recovery/context projections with readback.

requirements.title: GitHub source + CI authority
requirements.requirement: Repository branches/PRs/exact-head CI govern code integration.

requirements.title: Gmail checkpoint channel
requirements.requirement: Detailed human START/END checkpoints use Gmail with provider acknowledgement.

requirements.title: Telegram cockpit
requirements.requirement: Telegram provides human-visible status/cockpit and secondary communication path.

requirements.title: CORE/ADAPTER separation
requirements.requirement: Core state/orchestration is separated from replaceable providers/adapters.

requirements.title: PROJECT_HEAD semantics
requirements.requirement: Canonical mutations advance a fenced head/revision, never silent multi-master state.

requirements.title: Error ledger
requirements.requirement: Failures become durable generalized evidence rather than ephemeral chat text.

requirements.title: Inbox/outbox
requirements.requirement: Durable inbox/outbox queues support disconnected work and later reconciliation.

requirements.title: Model/provider broker
requirements.requirement: Multiple free/available providers are replaceable; quota failure is HOLD/retry, never forced payment.

requirements.title: Checkpointed jobs
requirements.requirement: Long work is split into durable checkpoints with resumable next action.

requirements.title: Content-addressed vault/cache
requirements.requirement: Large/reusable artifacts and context are addressed by content hash with bounded local storage.

requirements.title: Time trust
requirements.requirement: Receipts/events carry explicit observed/generated times and avoid assuming wall-clock truth after outages.

requirements.title: LAN anti-entropy
requirements.requirement: Nodes reconcile state after local partitions without silently creating conflicting canonical heads.

requirements.title: Incarnation/epoch/fencing
requirements.requirement: Restarts and coordinator changes are protected by epoch/fencing/revision preconditions.

requirements.title: Security classes
requirements.requirement: Operations are categorized by risk/permission and unsafe ambiguity fails closed.

requirements.title: Zero-dollar default
requirements.requirement: No automatic purchase, paid API, recharge or mandatory paid cloud dependency.

requirements.title: Secret separation
requirements.requirement: Tokens/pairing secrets never live in public repo or exported context projections.

requirements.title: Low-resource PC profile
requirements.requirement: PC work is bounded for ~4GB RAM, one heavy job at a time, degraded modes under pressure.

requirements.title: Three-level durability
requirements.requirement: Hot local state, durable local DB/receipts, and external recovery mirrors cooperate without one single point of failure.

requirements.title: Phone-primary Edge/API appliance
requirements.requirement: Dedicated phone is preferred persistent low-power appliance node; PC is not communications center.

requirements.title: Authenticated local phone API
requirements.requirement: Phone exposes bounded authenticated status/sync/jobs/context surfaces and public minimal health/capabilities.

requirements.title: Phone durable Room/SQLite authority
requirements.requirement: Phone keeps queue, receipts, memory/index and store-forward state in transactional local DB.

requirements.title: Phone local scheduler
requirements.requirement: Deterministic local jobs run on phone without waiting for PC where capability permits.

requirements.title: Phone context compiler
requirements.requirement: Phone can build compact project/context packs locally and serve them through authenticated API.

requirements.title: Adaptive private cache
requirements.requirement: Phone uses bounded app-private cache/content store with reserve; never consumes entire 64GB device.

requirements.title: Foreground server lifecycle
requirements.requirement: A user-visible foreground connected-device/remote-messaging service hosts the persistent local node when allowed.

requirements.title: Boot/package restore
requirements.requirement: Phone restores server capability after reboot/package replacement under Android lifecycle rules.

requirements.title: WorkManager reconciliation
requirements.requirement: Deferrable reconciliation/drain work uses WorkManager rather than assuming immortal process residency.

requirements.title: LAN NSD discovery
requirements.requirement: Phone advertises/discovers BCP services on shared LAN without manual IP entry.

requirements.title: Wi-Fi Direct fallback
requirements.requirement: Phone/PC may discover/connect directly without normal LAN/hotspot when hardware/permission supports it.

requirements.title: BLE control/presence fallback
requirements.requirement: BLE is available for low-bandwidth discovery/control hints, not bulk payload transport.

requirements.title: USB fallback path
requirements.requirement: Architecture reserves USB/tether/local link as a manual last-resort local path when practical.

requirements.title: Metered/data-saver routing
requirements.requirement: Phone and PC classify metered/unmetered connectivity and minimize PC mobile-data use.

requirements.title: Store-and-forward communications
requirements.requirement: Messages/commands/telemetry queue durably when no uplink exists and drain idempotently later.

requirements.title: Telegram selective phone relay
requirements.requirement: Phone can relay Telegram-bound control traffic while preserving Telegram TLS and strict allowlist.

requirements.title: Telegram ownership lease
requirements.requirement: Only one active inbound Telegram poller/webhook owner exists; failover is explicit/leased to avoid conflicts.

requirements.title: Adaptive transport scoring
requirements.requirement: Runtime chooses LAN/hotspot/Wi-Fi Direct/BLE/USB/remote based on reachability, cost, power and payload class.

requirements.title: Resumable chunk transfer
requirements.requirement: Large artifacts use chunking/hash/resume and do not restart from zero after weak-network interruption.

requirements.title: Resource governor
requirements.requirement: Phone/PC throttle CPU, RAM, wakeups, retries, cache and transfer rates under heat/battery/memory pressure.

requirements.title: Permission onboarding
requirements.requirement: Dedicated-phone UI requests only capabilities actually used: notifications, Nearby Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, battery mode, etc.

requirements.title: Android lifecycle compliance
requirements.requirement: Foreground/background restrictions, Doze and modern target-SDK limits are explicitly handled instead of assuming an immortal service.

requirements.title: Device-owner advanced mode optional
requirements.requirement: An invasive dedicated-device mode may be evaluated separately, never hidden as baseline or factory-reset requirement.

requirements.title: Chronicle + supersession memory
requirements.requirement: Memory tracks lineage/supersession/conflicts rather than replacing one giant summary file.

requirements.title: Context pack integrity
requirements.requirement: Context projections carry revisions/hashes/freshness/export class and are reproducible from source revision.

requirements.title: Fast BCPGO bootstrap
requirements.requirement: Fresh conversation loads compact bootstrap/project context rather than broad Drive/GitHub scans.

requirements.title: Per-turn delta protocol
requirements.requirement: Consumers use UNCHANGED/DELTA/FULL_REFRESH/CONFLICT/DEGRADED/HOLD semantics for revision-aware context refresh.

requirements.title: Three-node partition safety
requirements.requirement: B-EDGE, PC-WORKER and NEXUS survive pairwise partitions without split-brain PROJECT_HEAD.

requirements.title: Pre-human representative simulation
requirements.requirement: User click/install/retry paths are simulated in Windows/Android CI when technically reproducible.

requirements.title: Server-first human UI
requirements.requirement: Phone UI shows node health, transports, queue, memory, permissions, autonomy and diagnostics instead of pretending to be only a PC client.

requirements.title: Gmail START before work
requirements.requirement: Every user-invoked tranche sends/acks labeled BCP START before substantive work.

requirements.title: Gmail END before app reply
requirements.requirement: Every tranche sends complete END and verifies SENT/provider message_id before ChatGPT final pointer.

requirements.title: 25-minute cadence
requirements.requirement: Canonical cadence is 25 minutes total: ~23 useful work + ~2 closeout reserve.

requirements.title: Primary close owner, no normal automation dependency
requirements.requirement: Active assistant owns normal close; scheduled guards are not the normal path.

requirements.title: Delivery-key idempotence
requirements.requirement: START/END are tracked by unique delivery key + Gmail search + provider message_id to prevent duplicates/missing closes.

requirements.title: Append-only communication ledger
requirements.requirement: Communication receipts survive chat/UI loss and allow crash-window recovery.

requirements.title: ChatGPT pointer-only after END
requirements.requirement: Detailed checkpoint stays in Gmail; app shows only Gmail/date/time/checkpoint after ACK.

requirements.title: BCP Gmail label
requirements.requirement: All BCP START/END mail is labeled BCP for deterministic recovery/search.

requirements.title: Fresh conversation without re-explanation
requirements.requirement: BCPGO BCP reloads communication, A+B+C spec, writer fence, state and next action without asking user to reconstruct history.

requirements.title: User not telemetry bus
requirements.requirement: System checks GitHub/Drive/telemetry/connectors itself before asking for screenshots/commands.

requirements.title: No micro-beta install loop
requirements.requirement: Do not repeatedly make user install tiny increments; publish one coherent qualified full-node candidate.

requirements.title: Full use of dedicated phone
requirements.requirement: 4GB/64GB dedicated Android carries meaningful memory, orchestration, communication and local execution workload.

requirements.title: PC is specialized worker, not sole center
requirements.requirement: PC handles Windows/heavy compute/build/sign/compatibility while communications/state can survive without it.

requirements.title: No SIM assumption on old phone
requirements.requirement: Phone full-node works on LAN/hotspot/local links and does not require its own SIM.

requirements.title: RDC unstable network/power
requirements.requirement: Architecture treats brownouts, poor Wi-Fi, mobile hotspot changes and abrupt device loss as normal test cases.

requirements.title: Zero additional spend
requirements.requirement: Existing/free resources only; quota exhaustion becomes checkpoint/HOLD/retry, not payment.

requirements.title: Concrete UI before field install
requirements.requirement: Android emulator must verify actual screens/buttons/permissions/status before asking user to install.

requirements.title: Communication P0 over product polish
requirements.requirement: Continuity/Gmail/Telegram/ledger failures are repaired before cosmetic/product expansion.

requirements.title: A+B+C coverage gate
requirements.requirement: Every release/change maps to the whole A+B+C ledger; partial-scope success cannot masquerade as product completion.

requirements.title: Truthful completion percentage
requirements.requirement: Completion percentage is computed from evidence-backed capability states and distinguishes design/code/CI/field proof.
